title: Codeshare Flight? Which Flight Number to Give Your Driver
description: Booking an airport pickup for a codeshare flight? Match the final arriving leg, operating airline, full flight number and local date before confirming the ride.
cta: Make sure the flight and the pickup describe the same arrival.
image_alt: An unbranded passenger jet outside an airport window, with a second view reflected in the glass beside empty gate seats.
body:
For an airport pickup on a codeshare flight, give the transportation provider the final flight arriving at your pickup airport, its full local arrival date and the airline actually operating it. If your ticket also shows a partner airline's flight number, include that number and ask the provider to confirm which identifier it has recorded. Both numbers may describe the same aircraft; neither number alone establishes your agreed pickup time.

The useful check is whether the airline, flight number, origin, destination and arrival date all point to the same flight. This is especially helpful when a travel organizer booked the ticket or your journey includes a connection.

Find the operating airline on the final leg

A codeshare is a flight marketed through a partner airline. ANA's codeshare explanation describes flights carrying an ANA number that are operated by another carrier. Miles & More's flight-number guidance explains that the operating carrier can appear beside the words “operated by” on the passenger receipt. These sources were checked November 25, 2026.

Open the itinerary for the flight that actually lands at SFO, OAK, SJC or your other pickup airport. A first flight from your home city is not the arriving flight if you connect elsewhere. Record the airline name together with the number; the digits without the airline identifier can be ambiguous.

  • Ticketed flight: the airline and full flight number shown on your booking.
  • Operated by: the carrier named for that particular leg, plus its flight number if supplied by the airline.
  • Route: the departure airport for that leg and the airport where the car will collect you.
  • Arrival date: the complete calendar date at the destination, with the scheduled local arrival time.

If you cannot identify the operating flight number, send the details you can verify and ask the airline or provider to help reconcile them. Do not invent a second number or replace a confirmed identifier with a guess.

Compare flight status with the ride confirmation

Check the airline's current itinerary and status, then compare them with the ride confirmation. SFO's flight-status page says its times use local Pacific Time and directs travelers to check status with their airline. A flight missing from a limited airport search window does not, by itself, prove that it has been canceled.

Illustrative example: your booking lists a partner-airline code, while the operating airline uses another code for the same final flight into SFO. Send both codes with the same route and local arrival date, and ask the ride provider to confirm the match. That is one arrival to reconcile, not two cars to book. This example does not establish a real airline partnership or a flight schedule.

Confirm the pickup arrangement separately: the meeting point, the agreed pickup time or readiness procedure, and whom you should contact after landing. Do not infer a terminal from the airline that sold the ticket, or assume that a touchdown estimate includes leaving the aircraft, border procedures and collecting bags.

Send a short flight-matching message

“For ride [reference], our final arriving leg is [origin] to [pickup airport] on [full local date], scheduled to arrive at [local time]. The ticket shows [airline and flight number], operated by [carrier; operating flight number if verified]. Please confirm the flight recorded for this ride and the agreed pickup arrangements.”

If rebooking changes the actual flight, use the flight-change checklist and get acknowledgment of the amendment. For overnight journeys, check our arrival-date guide. If someone else made the reservation, give the traveler the passenger handoff details.

For a new journey, explore Koast airport transfers and request a quote with the verified arriving-flight details, passengers, bags and destination. For an existing ride, use your confirmation's contact or agreed day-of-trip contact and obtain acknowledgment of any change. A new quote request does not amend an existing reservation.
